reason: I don't take supplements unless a doctor tells me to, and nobody has told me I'm low on magnesium. I can get a bottle of magnesium at a drugstore for under $15, so $30 a month for the same thing in a foil packet isn't worth it to me.
objection: I have no proof I need it, and I'd be paying double for the packaging. Two capsules a day, every day, for something I'm not sure does anything.
would_change_my_mind: My doctor telling me my magnesium is low and recommending it. Even then it would have to be close to drugstore price.
